problems.reason: Both sentences state that Zhuchengtitan is known from a single humerus.
Both sentences describe the discovery of the humerus at the Zangjiazhuang Quarry in 2008.
Sentence 17 gives an age of 73.5 Ma for the Hongtuya Member, while sentence 18 states Zhuchengtitan lived approximately 72 Ma.
